readme.summary: Reasonably clear documentation for a deprecated tool, covering installation and basic usage but lacking troubleshooting guidance and real-world examples.
readme.top_issue: Project is deprecated with no maintained alternatives integrated into the docs — users are redirected away immediately, and the existing content is for an unmaintained tool.

injection_risks.description: The use of fmt.Errorf could potentially lead to information disclosure if not properly sanitized.
The Options struct has a Path field which is used in file operations. If this path is user-controlled, it could lead to path traversal attacks.

critical_findings: Potential path traversal attacks through the Path field in Options struct
security.summary: The code has some potential security issues, including information disclosure and path traversal attacks, but overall it appears to be well-structured and follows good practices.

common_complaints: No module manager found error persists across multiple platforms/versions (2021-2024)
Tool fails to detect or support common project types (Gradle, Cargo workspaces, .Net, Ruby)

Incomplete or failed SBOM generation with minimal debugging info
Missing support for modern package managers (pnpm)
